body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Magellan introduced its handheld GPS ‘Triton 2000’ during CES 2008, which adopts 2.7-inch color touch screen, 2M camera, an embedded speaker and microphone and SD card slot. Other features included multimedia player, 3-axis electronic compass, barometer function and LED flashlight.
